title: Data ingestion and provenance connectors
summary: Dataset contracts, fail-closed provenance, local CSV/Parquet/Arrow ingestion, optional Polars path, synthetic public-data adapter, and benchmark/scenario links are available.

public_adapters.notes: Synthetic open fixture only; does not fetch external restricted data.

limitations: Polars is optional and may be absent in base environments.
Legacy OECD helper is not a production-ready licensed adapter.
No dataset hosting or scraping without explicit permission.
